title: explorer browser qualification stalls in Install pinned browser engines (4 recurrences)
description:
The `explorer browser qualification (chromium · firefox · webkit)` job in ci.yml stalls in its "Install pinned browser engines" step and sits there until a human cancels the run. It runs on every PR and on the main push run, so each recurrence costs a cancel plus a re-run of the failed job, and a stall on the main push run leaves that run not green.

FOUR RECURRENCES on 2026-10-22, all read from the Actions API (jobs of attempt 1; `gh api repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/actions/runs/<id>/attempts/1/jobs`). "Sat" is step start to the moment the cancel took effect, which is NOT how long the stall would have lasted: nothing stopped it.
1. run 39819294463 (opum-ai/lore-cli#646, head a021f560), job 119965999711: step started 17:03:38Z, cancelled 17:41:14Z, sat ~37.6 min.
2. run 39830280984 (opum-ai/lore-cli#647, head 490b1a22), job 120004301250: step started 18:19:29Z, cancelled 18:39:34Z (by a superseding push), sat ~20.1 min.
3. run 39836856767 (opum-ai/lore-cli#648, head b6d4b021), job 120027327327: step started 19:04:30Z, cancelled 19:33:18Z, sat ~28.8 min.
4. run 39857554409 (push to main, 6ff69788), job 120099602261: step started 21:28:48Z, cancelled 21:55:10Z, sat ~26.4 min. Its attempt 2 (job 120111546065) started 21:55:22Z, entered the same step at 21:55:34Z and was still in it at the leader's 22:10:45Z read (15 min); it was cancelled 22:11:55Z. Not counted as a fifth, same run.
On the three PR runs the rerun of the failed job passed; on the main push run attempt 2 stalled in the same step and was cancelled at 22:11:55Z (job 120111546065, step start 21:55:34Z). The passing reruns' install step ran 43-85 s (e.g. run 39813648687: 16:23:42Z -> 16:24:25Z, 43 s; run 39819294463 attempt 2: 17:41:36Z -> 17:43:01Z, 85 s), so a healthy install is about a minute and a stall is not a slow install.

THE STEP'S CURRENT DEFINITION (ci.yml, job explorer-browser-qualification, line numbers at dev ec4178db): `run: bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit` (about line 730). NO step-level timeout-minutes. The JOB carries `timeout-minutes: 40` (about line 723), set deliberately for a COLD install under slow mirrors (the comment cites run 32296206324, cancelled mid `apt-get Get:28 librsvg2-2`), so a hung step holds a runner for up to 40 minutes before GitHub fails it. `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: .lore/cache/ms-playwright` is set on the job but NO actions/cache step restores or saves it, so every run is a cold download (~500 MB across three engines, plus ~30 apt packages from azure.archive.ubuntu.com via --with-deps). The setup-bun composite caches only ~/.bun/install/cache.

PROPOSED FIX DIRECTION (not implemented; to be admitted separately): (1) at minimum a step-level `timeout-minutes` on the install step, around 5 min given a healthy install is ~1-1.5 min, so a stall fails in minutes instead of hanging toward 40; (2) a bounded retry around that step (a failed install is safe to repeat), since the rerun passed on all three PR runs (it stalled again on the main push run, so a retry within the same runner pool is not a guarantee either); (3) consider actions/cache on `.lore/cache/ms-playwright` keyed on the pinned Playwright version, so the engine download is not repeated every run (the apt step of --with-deps still is, so this alone is not a fix). Note the existing 40 m job comment: a cold install legitimately took ~15 min in a slow burst, so a 5 min step cap needs a measured value, not a guess; measure the install-step duration distribution across recent runs before choosing the number. Open question for the reviewer: whether this job's required status on dev (read live from ruleset 22838594 at 2026-10-22: the six required contexts are docker e2e harness, lint·typecheck·test on windows and ubuntu, Tracker integrity, lore check (docs gate) and compile smoke (ubuntu); this job is not one of them) should change. It is not required, which is why landings proceeded on a stall.
implementationNotes: Fix built (branch fix/lcli-753-browser-install-timeout): scripts/run-bounded.mjs wraps the install with a per-attempt timeout (300 s) killing the whole process group, max 2 attempts, red when all fail (no continue-on-error, no || true); step timeout-minutes: 12. DERIVATION: 36 passing runs of this step read from the Actions API on 2026-10-22 took 42-89 s (median ~54 s); 300 s = 3.4x the slowest healthy install; 12 min = both attempts at cap (10 min) + kill grace + headroom, and a backstop if the wrapper hangs. No actions/cache on PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: the apt half of --with-deps repeats every run regardless, so a cache would not remove the stall and adds a stale-browsers-pass risk. Proofs: unit tests run the real script against a hung command (killed in ~2 s, exit 1), a hung grandchild (killed with the group), a one-failure-then-success retry, all-fail red, and usage errors; 7 mutations each turn tests red.

SESSION HANDOFF lore-cli 2026-10-22T22:49Z

STATE. PR opum-ai/lore-cli#654 (branch fix/lcli-753-browser-install-timeout) is OPEN, unmerged, head 6f217da69729ed026f921a8805b44cc0e5bba684, RED: its own explorer browser qualification job failed (run 39866700524, job 120130575140); the other 12 checks are green. origin/dev is 8bd1dc06 (after #653, the LCLI-753 record); a promotion of dev to main is HELD until LCLI-753 lands. origin/main is 6ff69788. The lore RELEASE stays HELD (no tag, no publish): the release gate is red by design until a release carries new binary behaviour (LCLI-751 ruling A); LCLI-751's stale-control half stays open under opum-doc's ruling A, only its win32 extract half landed (#648, c35ec7e0).

DIAGNOSIS of the red (raw job log of run 39866700524, 22:41:11Z to 22:46:19Z). The install ran node scripts/run-bounded.mjs --timeout-seconds 300 --attempts 2 -- bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit. Attempt 1 was still downloading apt packages (Get:24 of the --with-deps set, after a 7.4 MB fonts package took ~90 s: a slow-mirror burst, the install was PROGRESSING) and timed out at 300 s. Attempt 2 failed in 2 s: "E: Could not get lock /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend. It is held by process 2735 (apt-get)", Playwright "Installation process exited with code: 100". Cause: --with-deps runs apt-get as ROOT via sudo ("Switching to root user to install dependencies..."); run-bounded.mjs's process-group kill runs as the runner user, cannot signal root-owned processes (EPERM is swallowed), so the orphaned apt-get kept the dpkg lock and the retry could never succeed. Two consequences: (1) a 300 s cap cuts slow-but-live installs (the 36-sample healthy baseline of 42-89 s held no slow burst); (2) a wrapper retry cannot work around a root-owned apt. The earlier scratch proofs missed this because their grandchild was same-user.

DECISION (leader, 2026-10-22, option C with apt-native resilience; recorded verbatim in substance): split the step into two. (1) "Install browser system deps": first write an apt config via sudo (e.g. /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/80-retries with Acquire::Retries "3"; Acquire::http::Timeout "60"; Acquire::https::Timeout "60";), then run bunx playwright install-deps chromium firefox webkit with a native step timeout-minutes of 20. NO wrapper retry: apt retries itself, and a root-owned apt cannot be killed and retried from the runner user. (2) "Install pinned browser engines": bunx playwright install chromium firefox webkit WITHOUT --with-deps, under the bounded runner (scripts/run-bounded.mjs), one retry, red fail. Every process there is runner-owned so the kill works. Derive its per-attempt cap from measured browser-download-only times read from the step logs, NOT from the combined install times. DROP option B: no sudo kill. A cache of PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH is optional, only if keyed to the pinned Playwright version (1.62.1 in package.json and bun.lock). PROOFS REQUIRED: one green real run; the same-user hung-install scratch proof for step 2 re-run on the FINAL script (draft scratch PR with install replaced by sleep 3600 at a 20 s cap, plus an if: always() orphan check; close unmerged and delete the branch); report which half took how long on the green run (the diagnostic the split exists for). PR #654 is reworked IN PLACE. Create a fresh review worktree at the new green head. Do NOT merge; a review unit comes first.

WHAT EXISTS ON THE BRANCH (to rework): scripts/run-bounded.mjs (per-attempt timeout, process-group kill, retry, red when all fail; the pid guard from 6f217da6 is in), test/run-bounded.test.ts (posix-only behavioural tests; keep), the ci.yml step (timeout-minutes 12, 300 s x 2) and its comment (derivation from the 36 baseline: 42-89 s, median 54 s, now known incomplete), test/ci-workflow.test.ts pins the step string, timeout-minutes 12, no continue-on-error, no || true: update it for the two steps. LOCAL GATES TO RUN BEFORE PUSHING (a missed one cost a red CI cycle): bun run typecheck (it caught a possibly-undefined child.pid), bun run lint on changed files, bun run lore check, bun test (solo, ~4.5 min). Mutation script pattern: scratchpad lcli753-mut.py.

PROOFS SO FAR (both on the wrapper before the split): scratch run 39866145482 (job 120128705760): hung sleep 3600 at a 20 s cap failed the step in 40 s, both attempts timed out; and scratch run 39866759599 (job 120130772104) on the byte-identical 6f217da6 script: failed 22:41:42Z to 22:42:22Z, both grandchild pids DEAD afterwards, none running. Scratch PRs #655 and #656 closed unmerged, branches deleted. They prove the wrapper for SAME-USER children only.

RECURRENCES for context (the stall the task is about): runs 39819294463 (#646), 39830280984 (#647), 39836856767 (#648), 39857554409 (main push, plus its attempt 2) stalled 20-38 min in Install pinned browser engines; #653's own run 39863242046 stalled a fifth time (landed on required contexts, the job is NOT a required context, read live from ruleset 22838594).
